transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Lee. Yes, I'm ready to present my review. I completed my review of the implementation draft yesterday, focusing on the family materials and lesson supports for multilingual learners. I have two important findings to share with the group. First, regarding the family materials: the current draft supplies these materials in English only, but my family review confirmed that take-home materials must be provided in English, Spanish, and Somali to ensure all of our families can access them. Second, regarding lesson supports: my review confirmed that every lesson must include teacher-provided oral directions for multilingual learners, which is not currently specified in the draft. I should also note that I completed this review yesterday but have not yet entered the results in the adoption tracker, so these findings are not yet reflected there. I'd also like to note, in light of Ms. Shah's findings, that the requirement for teacher-provided oral directions will apply to all ten lessons, not just the eight currently listed in the draft, and the paired podcast format may actually benefit our multilingual learners by providing peer support during the recording task.
